title_sq: Apartament 2+1+2 per shitje ne zonen e 5-Majit
description_sq:
Ne zonen e 5 Majit, shesim apartament 2+1+2 me planimetri te rregullt.
Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e 3-te banim te nje pallati shume te mire me ashensor dhe organizohet ne nje sallon ndenje se bashku me ambientin e gatimit, nje dhome gjumi matrimoniale, nje dhome gjumi femijesh, dy tualete ku njeri prej tyre eshte me dritare dhe nje ballkon te gjate ne te cilin ka dalje salloni.
Zona ne te cilen ndodhet apartamenti eshte nje zone shume e zhvilluar qe ploteson te gjitha sherbimet e nevojshme per nje jetese komode gjithashtu eshte shume prane Qendres por ka dhe akses ne linjat kryesore te autobusit.
Per me teper informacion ose nje vizite ne prone, me kontaktoni!
title_en: 2+1+2 apartment for sale in the 5-May area
description_en: In the 5 May area, we are selling a 2+1+2 apartment with a regular floor plan. The apartment is located on the 3rd residential floor of a very good building with an elevator and is organized in a living room together with a kitchen, a matrimonial bedroom, a children's bedroom, two toilets, one of which has a window and a long balcony with an exit to the living room. The area in which the apartment is located is a very developed area that provides all the necessary services for a comfortable life, it is also very close to the Center but also has access to the main bus lines. For more information or a visit to the property, contact me!
